replies.body: Good call, done in a94cddb28a0. `MessagingAttributesGetter` now has a default `getDestinationSubscriptionName` and `MessagingAttributesExtractor` emits it under the stable messaging semantic conventions, so `PulsarSubscriptionAttributesExtractor` is gone. Pulsar is the only instrumentation emitting the attribute today (nothing else in the repo, and none of the remaining PRs in the stack touch it), so nothing else changes.

replies.body:
You are right, it is deterministic and the loose assertion was unwarranted. Tightened in dca46db4c9c.

`startAndEndConsumerReceive` returns the ambient parent under the stable conventions and the receive context otherwise, and that is exactly the context `result.complete()` runs under, so the callback parent is the `receive-parent` span in the new conventions and the `receive` span in the old ones. That holds whether the future completes before or after the caller registers `whenComplete`, since the caller is inside `receive-parent` either way. Confirmed with four runs of `testMessagingPreview` and one of `test`.
